import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { oauthApplications } from "./oauth_applications";
import { users } from "./users";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to oauth_applications (its only NOT NULL foreign key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "token" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "refresh_token" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "revoked_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "created_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "scopes" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "previous_refresh_token" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const oauthAccessTokens = defineTable("oauth_access_tokens", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        resourceOwnerId: col.bigint(),
        applicationId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        token: col.text().notNull().unique(),
        refreshToken: col.text().unique(),
        expiresIn: col.integer(),
        revokedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        scopes: col.text(),
        previousRefreshToken: col.text().notNull().default("")
    },
    relations: {
        application: rel.belongsTo(() => oauthApplications, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        resourceOwner: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
